scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run build -w client && tsx --test client/test/connect.test.ts client/test/steer.test.ts client/test/clock.test.ts client/test/assets.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit
